title: Hypatia Graduate Summer School 2027
about: The Centre de Recerca Matemàtica (CRM) in Bellaterra, Spain, hosts the Hypatia Graduate Summer School from 21 June to 2 July 2027. Participants are selected from applications, with places capped at 40; the first-call deadline is 28 February 2027 and the second 30 April 2027.
